definitions.gloss: another day; a different day; an alternative date
definitions.explanation: A day other than the one originally planned or discussed. Often used when rescheduling appointments or events.

examples.japanese: {別|べつ}{日|じつ}に{変更|へんこう}する。
examples.english: To change to a different day.

examples.japanese: {都合|つごう}が{悪|わる}ければ{別|べつ}{日|じつ}でも{構|かま}いません。
examples.english: If it's not convenient, another day is fine too.

examples.japanese: {雨天|うてん}の{場合|ばあい}は{別|べつ}{日|じつ}に{延期|えんき}させていただきます。
examples.english: In the event of rain, we will postpone to another day.

notes:
A compound of {別|べつ} (different, separate) and {日|じつ} (day). Commonly used in scheduling and business contexts when proposing or requesting an alternative date.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別|べつ}{日|じつ}に{変更|へんこう}する: to change to another day
- {別|べつ}{日|じつ}に{延期|えんき}する: to postpone to another day
- {別|べつ}{日|じつ}を{設|もう}ける: to set up a different date
- {別|べつ}{日|じつ}でも{可|か}: another day is also acceptable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後日|ごじつ}: a later day — implies a future date, not just a different one
- {他|た}の{日|ひ}: another day — less formal, more conversational
- {改|あらた}めて: on another occasion — used as an adverb, broader than just changing dates
